name: mod_menu
title: Mod Menu for Luanti
short_description: In-game menu for loaded Luanti mods and registered settings screens.
long_description:
A regular Lua mod that adds `/modmenu`: a fullscreen in-game catalog for loaded Luanti mods.

Features:

- View loaded mods with search, sort, library filtering, badges, icons, and metadata from `mod.conf`.
- Open schema-based settings screens registered by other mods through `mod_menu.register_settings`.
- Use tabs, collapsible sections, Reset, Reset All, boolean buttons, enum dropdowns, fields, and numeric slider-style controls.
- Admins with the `server` privilege can control whether regular players can open Mod Menu and can disable settings screens per mod.

Compatibility target: Luanti 5.10+, Mineclonia, and VoxeLibre (`mineclone2`). The mod is still usable in other games.

Limitations:

- Stock Luanti Lua mods cannot add a stable button to the engine ESC/pause menu, so this port uses `/modmenu`.
- This is an unofficial Luanti port inspired by TerraformersMC Mod Menu and is not affiliated with or endorsed by TerraformersMC.
